description: Reply to a message in its thread; the reply is sent right away and cannot be recalled. It quotes the original and goes to the original's Reply-To or sender unless you set to; set replyAll to include all original recipients.

attachments.description: Attachments. Each item must specify exactly one of content (base64) or url

contentDisposition.description: inline to show it in the HTML body, attachment to offer it as a download

contentId.description: ID the HTML body references as cid:<contentId> to show it inline

contentType.description: MIME type, e.g. application/pdf; inferred when omitted

filename.description: File name recipients see, e.g. report.pdf

contentDisposition.description: inline to show it in the HTML body, attachment to offer it as a download

contentId.description: ID the HTML body references as cid:<contentId> to show it inline

contentType.description: MIME type, e.g. application/pdf; inferred when omitted

filename.description: File name recipients see, e.g. report.pdf

url.description: Publicly accessible URL to fetch the attachment from

items.description: Attachment: provide exactly one of content (base64) or url

bcc.description: Override BCC recipients. Cannot be combined with replyAll

cc.description: Override CC recipients. Cannot be combined with replyAll

html.description: HTML body for formatted mail; inline images use cid:<contentId>

inboxId.description: Inbox ID: the inbox's email address, from list_inboxes

labels.description: Your own labels for the message; AgentMail sets system labels such as sent

messageId.description: Message ID with its angle brackets, from list_messages, search_messages, or get_thread

replyAll.description: Reply to all original recipients. Mutually exclusive with to, cc, and bcc — the API rejects the request if both are set

replyTo.description: Addresses that replies should go to instead of this inbox

text.description: Plain-text body; include it even with html, since no text version is generated from html

to.description: Recipients, replacing the default: the original's Reply-To, else its sender (for a message this inbox sent, that is this inbox). Cannot be combined with replyAll
